Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Mandalorian and Baby Yoda Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8592]Mandalorian and Baby Yoda NPCs[/url] mod Character Mandalorian and Baby Yoda, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. Including without helmet portraits.

*Make sure you have PyTK mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [/size][url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000
[/url]
[size=3]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8592]Mandalorian and Baby Yoda NPCs[/url] mod is compatible with the current version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120?tab=description]Boarding House and Bus Stop Extension[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] mod (I use them both in my own playthrough). However, if you are adding the Mandalorian mod to an already existing save there are chances there'll be some bushes clipping through the Razor Crest. If that bothers you you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9350]Reset Terrain Features For .NET 5[/url] to remove those bushes.[/size]


Find where you installed your Mandalorian and Baby Yoda mod (some where in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder)
Drag the "[b][CP] Mandalorian Grogu[/b]" folder from my Zip into the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[NPC] Mandalorian and Baby Yoda[/b] folder to overwrite the "[b][CP] Mandalorian Grogu[/b]" folder in it.

This mod replaces the portrait of Mandalorian and Baby Yoda.
If the portraits is not showing, please make sure the folder overwrites the correct files.


Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.

Added a new version in the optional file for people who want to install the portraits with portraiture.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8592]Mandalorian and Baby Yoda NPCs[/url] mod.)

The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8592]Mandalorian and Baby Yoda NPCs[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/115665713]BexTX[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
